title: Kicked Norwegian Beef Dumplings
description: Spicy, creamy dumplings filled with tender chuck roast, served in a rich, velvety sauce that feels like a hug from the North.
instructions: Season the chuck roast cubes with salt and pepper and set aside.
Heat a large pot over medium heat, melt the butter, and add the diced onion, cooking until translucent.
Add the minced garlic, paprika, and cayenne pepper, sautéing for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Increase the heat to high and brown the seasoned roast cubes on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Pour in 400 ml of water, reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer the meat for 1 hour until tender.
In a small bowl, whisk together the flour, egg, and heavy cream to form a thick dough.
Drop spoonfuls of dough into the simmering broth; cover and let the dumplings steam for 10 minutes, or until they float and are cooked through.
Reduce the sauce to a creamy consistency, stirring in the remaining heavy cream and adjusting seasoning.
Serve the dumplings hot, garnished with chopped dill and a drizzle of the thickened sauce.
